english.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for putting someone or something in a specific location.
Use 放 as the all-purpose choice for physically placing someone or something somewhere.
Use 放 as the all-purpose verb for placing something somewhere, including ordinary storage; use 收埋 when putting it away for safekeeping is emphasized.
Use 放 when you put or leave an object somewhere, especially when it is to remain there or be collected later.

examples.english: Please place the book on the table for me.
examples.jyutping: nei5 bong1 ngo5 fong3 bun2 syu1 hai2 toi2 min6

examples.english: I put the book on the table.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 bun2 syu1 fong3 hai2 toi4 min6

examples.english: You can deposit the book on the table for now.
examples.traditional: 你可以將本書放喺張枱度先。
examples.jyutping: nei5 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 bun2 syu1 fong3 hai2 zoeng1 toi2 dou6 sin1

examples.english: I’ll leave the documents at the reception desk; you can pick them up later.
examples.traditional: 我放份文件喺前台，你得閒自己攞。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 fong3 fan6 man4 gin6 hai2 cin4 toi4 nei5 dak1 haan4 zi6 gei2 lo2
